categories.main_business_segments: Dawning Information Industry Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of high-end computers, storage, security, and data center products. The company also focuses on digital infrastructure construction and intelligent computing services, including cloud computing, big data, and AI computing platforms. It operates a full industry chain covering upstream chips, servers, storage, midstream cloud computing platforms, and downstream cloud service providers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes self-developed core technologies including high-end computing systems, liquid cooling technologies (immersion and cold plate liquid cooling), distributed and centralized flash storage systems, AI software stacks, and integrated computing solutions. It employs intelligent manufacturing with smart production lines, digital procurement, and quality control algorithms to enhance efficiency and product quality. The company also develops full-stack AI computing platforms and green data center solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises and public utilities, with significant sales to government, financial services, healthcare, education, transportation, industrial manufacturing, and media sectors. The company serves over 100 industries and thousands of application scenarios, focusing on digital transformation and intelligent computing needs. Major customers contribute a large portion of sales, with the top five customers accounting for nearly 88% of total sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major regional markets in the Eastern, Southern, Western, and Northern districts of China. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and Singapore, and is exploring international data center markets such as Malaysia and Singapore. The company’s products and services support national and regional digital infrastructure projects across multiple provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dawning Information Industry operates across the entire supply chain from upstream chip manufacturing and server hardware production, through midstream cloud computing and big data platforms, to downstream cloud service provision. It holds a vertically integrated position with investments in upstream chip companies and midstream cloud and data center operators, enabling control over core components and integrated solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent computing, green computing technologies, and domestic core components to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers. It invests heavily in R&D for AI computing platforms, liquid cooling technologies, and integrated storage solutions. Strategic initiatives include building a nationwide integrated computing service platform, advancing AI model repositories, and promoting sustainable, energy-efficient data centers. Collaboration with academia and industry partners supports open ecosystem development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of IT equipment including high-end servers, storage systems, and network security products. Additional income derives from software development, system integration, cloud computing services, and technical support. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and government subsidies related to technology development and infrastructure projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dawning Information Industry is positioned as a leading domestic high-end computing and digital infrastructure provider in China, with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities. It competes with other domestic and international IT infrastructure companies, leveraging its integrated supply chain and focus on AI and green computing to differentiate. The company holds significant market share in government and enterprise sectors and is recognized as a key player in China's intelligent computing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 13.15 billion, a slight decline of 8.4% year-over-year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 4.1% to RMB 1.91 billion. Total assets grew by 15.82% to RMB 36.62 billion, and net assets increased by 9.4% to RMB 20.4 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and infrastructure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its self-developed core technologies, integrated full-stack computing solutions, and advanced liquid cooling systems as key differentiators. Its ability to provide high-performance, energy-efficient, and secure computing infrastructure tailored to AI and big data applications offers unique customer value. The comprehensive ecosystem spanning chips to cloud services and commitment to green computing further distinguish its offerings in the competitive landscape.
